title: PolBiX: Detecting LLMs’ Political Bias in Fact-Checking through X-phemisms
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political bias (left vs. right leaning) and the effect of judgmental language on truthfulness assessment. While it references the ethical implications of using LLMs for fact-checking and includes 'social' values like tradition or inclusivity on its political axes, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith traditions, or specific moral philosophies as its primary component.
